item.title: Ivanti zero-day exploited in the wild (CVE-2026-12345)
item.dc:creator: Jane Doe
item.description: Ivanti warns customers that CVE-2026-12345 is being exploited.
item.content:encoded:
Ivanti has warned customers that a critical vulnerability in Connect Secure, tracked as CVE-2026-12345, is being actively exploited in the wild. The flaw allows remote code execution without authentication.

Admins should patch immediately. Synology and Ubiquiti devices are not affected.
